title: Interview with John Rodriguez, CHRT’s new communications manager
summary: We at CHRT are excited to welcome John Rodriguez as our new communications manager. John is a strategic communications professional with more than a decade of experience at the University of Michigan. As communications manager at CHRT, he will lead communications efforts that translate research into accessible stories, elevate community voices, and support evidence-based policy… Continue Reading Interview with John Rodriguez, CHRT’s new communications manager The post Interview with John Rodriguez, CHRT’s new communications manager appeared first on Center for Health & Research Transformation .
